item.text: I’ll apply the supplied efficient-coding instructions, scan for credentials without displaying their values, and replace them with consistent placeholders. Then I’ll verify the changes and check that no unrelated files were modified.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import os,re,subprocess
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-co','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\\0')
p=re.compile(r'(?i)(api[_ -]?key|access[_ -]?key|secret|token|password|credential|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|github_pat_|hf_[a-zA-Z0-9]+)')
for f in sorted(set(files)):
 if not f or not os.path.isfile(f): continue
 try: s=open(f,encoding='utf8').read()
 except (UnicodeError,OSError): continue
 for n,l in enumerate(s.splitlines(),1):
  if p.search(l):
   safe=re.sub(r'([\\\"\\x27])(?:(?"'!'"\\1).)*?\\1',lambda m:m.group(1)+'[redacted]'+m.group(1),l)
   safe=re.sub(r'(?i)(AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|github_pat_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+|hf_[a-zA-Z0-9]+','[redacted]',safe)
   print(f'{f}:{n}: {safe[:200]}')
print('HISTORY_COMMITS',subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--all','--count']).decode().strip())
PY"
